description: This file defines a plugin for managing Talk voice configurations, including listing, setting, and displaying status of voices, with command registration and configuration handling.

methods.name: mask
methods.description: Masks a string, keeping only the first 'keep' characters.

methods.name: isLikelyVoiceId
methods.description: Checks if a string is a likely voice ID based on length and character set.

methods.name: resolveProviderLabel
methods.description: Returns a human-readable label for a provider ID.

methods.name: formatVoiceMeta
methods.description: Formats voice metadata into a string.

methods.name: formatVoiceList
methods.description: Formats a list of voices into a display string.

methods.name: findVoice
methods.description: Finds a voice matching a query by ID or name.

methods.name: asTrimmedString
methods.description: Converts a value to a trimmed string.

methods.name: resolveCommandLabel
methods.description: Returns command label based on channel type.

methods.name: asProviderBaseUrl
methods.description: Extracts a base URL string from a value.

methods.name: requiresAdminToSetVoice
methods.description: Determines if admin privileges are required to set voice based on channel and scopes.
